# Neon signs for the back wall: a five-point star, a ring, a zigzag bolt. Flat, 6 cm thick, facing
# the camera (-Y). Each centred on its own origin, placed in the bake. Up Z.
new
material new Star --base-color 1.0000 0.8196 0.0000 --emission 1.0000 0.8196 0.0000 --no-slot
material new Ring --base-color 1.0000 0.1490 0.4549 --emission 1.0000 0.1490 0.4549 --no-slot
material new Bolt --base-color 0.0627 0.8235 0.4588 --emission 0.0627 0.8235 0.4588 --no-slot
add mesh circle --name Star --vertices 10 --radius 0.45 --cap-fill triangle-fan --location -2.6 0 0 --rotation 90 0 18
apply --rotation
active Star
mode edit
select vert where "index % 2 == 1 && index < 10"
push-pull -0.24
select all
extrude 0 -0.06 0
mode object
material assign Star
add mesh torus --name Ring --major-radius 0.38 --minor-radius 0.07 --major-segments 14 --minor-segments 4 --location 2.6 0 0 --rotation 90 0 0
apply --rotation
material assign Ring
add mesh cube --name B0 --size 1 --location 0.0 0 0.32
scale 0.5 0.06 0.12
apply --scale
set rotation 0 30 0
apply --rotation
material assign Bolt
add mesh cube --name B1 --size 1 --location 0.0 0 0.0
scale 0.5 0.06 0.12
apply --scale
set rotation 0 -30 0
apply --rotation
material assign Bolt
add mesh cube --name B2 --size 1 --location 0.0 0 -0.32
scale 0.5 0.06 0.12
apply --scale
set rotation 0 30 0
apply --rotation
material assign Bolt
select B0 B1 B2
active B0
join
rename B0 Bolt
translate 0 0 0
select all
shade flat
export neon.glb
